_about: Built by files/pirate-ship/economy/build-economy-data.py from skill-tree.json and GOODS.md. Do not edit by hand. Marks: source = a period record (GOODS.md Part 4); proposed = this session's placement for Rex; unsourced = Rex's design addition with no period source; estimate = worked out from sourced inputs (GOODS.md 1j). basePrice is null everywhere: the balance lane sets it; the sourced price text is beside it. The five per-settlement numbers (stock, consumption per day, target reserve, production per day, base price) belong to a ports file that does not exist yet (ALIGNMENT §10).

flags.offMap: made outside the game's playable map in the base game (the Caribbean); origin says where. Whether a place is on the map is the map's decision, not this flag's (review, 2026-10-29)
flags.input: needs a good from another skill (the chain the economy follows)
flags.gate: needs another skill at some level to reach the place (Swimming for depth); that skill makes nothing
flags.unsourced: Rex's addition with no period source found; a design good, not a historical record
flags.inputAny: one of several inputs will do (a ropewalk spins its own yarn from raw fibre, or takes a spinner's)
flags.inputs: every listed input is needed (gunpowder takes all three)
flags.service: a service, not a traded good: the skill is used on people or ships, and the chip shows what that level can do
flags.knowledge: common = every tradesman of the skill knows it here; learned = must be taught or read; foreign = comes only with a far-travelled merchant or a book from another continent (Rex, 2026-10-29). Unset means common
flags.region: where a good or recipe belongs: caribbean (the base game) or an expansion region from REGIONS.md. Unset means caribbean. A good from another region reaches the Caribbean only through a rare-items trader, the odd ship, or a merchant's stall (Rex, 2026-10-29)
flags.origin: where in the Atlantic world a base-game good comes from: caribbean, west-africa, europe, north-america, spanish-main, brazil, atlantic-islands, asia (GOODS.md 1l). Unset means caribbean
flags.byproductOf: this good comes out of another recipe's run as well (molasses drains from the sugar pots): the engine yields it alongside, in a ratio the balance lane sets

facilities.note: Equipment a recipe needs and does not consume (Rex's rule: materials + equipment + band). A settlement has or lacks each; the engine checks it before the band. Added 2026-10-29 after the data review.

list.mill: a grist mill (wind, water or hand)
list.foundry: a gunfounder's furnace and boring mill
